# Exercise TREK Education

> > A comprehensive evidence-based platform for exercise prescription, rehabilitation, and athletic performance optimization grounded in mechanotherapy, pain science, and clinical reasoning.

Exercise TREK Education provides healthcare professionals and athletes with structured guidance on exercise prescription principles, therapeutic interventions, and fitness assessment. The platform integrates contemporary sports science research with practical clinical frameworks for injury recovery and performance enhancement.

## Key Topics

- Exercise prescription
- Mechanotherapy
- Load management
- Tissue repair
- Motor learning
- Pain science
- Periodisation
- Therapeutic exercise
- Fitness assessment
- Aerobic endurance testing
- VO2max
- Clinical reasoning
- Injury recovery
- Recovery strategies
- Training variables

## Core Principles & Foundations

- [Exercise Prescription Principles](https://exercise.trekeducation.org): Homepage and foundational overview of TREK exercise prescription education platform
- [Principles](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles): Core exercise principles including mechanotherapy and load management frameworks
- [Therapeutic Exercise Prescription](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/therapeutic-exercise-prescription): Therapeutic exercise prescription framework and clinical reasoning for rehabilitation
- [Pain Science](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/pain-science): Pain science fundamentals and pain classification in rehabilitation contexts
- [Motor Control & Motor Learning](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/motor-learning): Motor control and learning principles for rehabilitation therapy and skill acquisition

## Program Design & Training

- [Designing a Program](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles/designing-a-program): Guide to designing exercise programs with training variables and progressive overload
- [Periodisation](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles/periodisation): Periodisation and training planning strategies for strength conditioning and performance
- [Tissue Repair](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles/tissue-repair): Tissue repair and mechanotransduction mechanisms in exercise rehabilitation
- [Load Management](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles/load-management): Load management principles and POLICE framework for injury recovery and prevention

## Assessment & Evaluation

- [Assessment](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment): Fitness assessment methods including strength and endurance testing protocols
- [Aerobic Endurance Testing](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment/aerobic-endurance-testing): Aerobic endurance testing protocols including 6MWT and step tests for cardiovascular fitness
- [6 Minute Walk Test (6-MWT)](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment/aerobic-endurance-testing/6-minute-walk-test): 6 Minute Walk Test protocol and patient instructions for functional capacity assessment
- [Cooper's 12 Minute Run Test](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment/aerobic-endurance-testing/coopers-12-minute-run-test): Cooper's 12 minute run test for VO2max assessment and aerobic fitness evaluation
- [2.4 KM Run Test](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment/aerobic-endurance-testing/2-4-km-run-test): 2.4 km run test protocol with VO2max calculation and normative fitness standards

## Recovery & Performance Optimization

- [Recovery](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles/recovery): Recovery techniques including sleep and water therapy strategies for athletic performance
- [Sleep](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/principles/recovery/sleep): Sleep recovery and sleep hygiene practices for athlete performance optimization
- [Water Therapy](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/water-therapy-2): Water therapy and cold immersion protocols for athletic recovery and rehabilitation

## Optional

- [2 Minute Step Test](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment/aerobic-endurance-testing/2-minute-step-test): 2 Minute Step Test procedure for lower body endurance and functional capacity assessment
- [Beep Test](https://exercise.trekeducation.org/assessment/aerobic-endurance-testing/beep-test): Beep test protocol for aerobic endurance and VO2 max estimation in field settings
